semantic_metrics.ftp_default_overwrite_true: Candidate actual fields explicitly say FTP overwrites by default; mere FTP/overwrite title does not pass.
semantic_metrics.explicit_false_appends: Candidate actual fields correctly distinguish explicit overwrite=False appending from default True.
semantic_metrics.appe_exception: Candidate actual fields retain some FTP servers may not support APPE append.
semantic_metrics.wrong_backend_generalization: Record explicit unjustified transfer of FTP default or exception to other backends.
semantic_metrics.complete_target_rule: At least one native-accepted candidate must express default True, explicit False append, APPE condition, without scope error; absence does not prove a false assertion.

semantic_method: Manual inspection of all actual candidate fields with quoted field evidence; no judge model or keyword-only verdict.
empty_plan_semantics: NO_CANDIDATE; target semantics not expressed, scope-error metric not applicable.
causal_limits: same fingerprint not full server equivalence
all document metadata identities deliberately held fixed
Plan candidate does not establish final Skill quality
